pack_id: P5-THEROS — Pantheon, poleis, geography and perils in the official plane primer

ths_plane.title: Theros
ths_plane.perspective: Wizards of the Coast (official Magic Story)

entities.name: Learning, progress, magic and religious devotion in Meletis

claims.subject: theros
claims.source_excerpt: ruled by an awe-inspiring pantheon of gods
claims.summary: The official Theros profile describes the plane as ruled by a pantheon of gods whose whims and wrath affect mortals.
claims.limitation: This describes the pantheon's broad influence, not a complete list of gods or a formal constitutional government.

claims.subject: theros
claims.source_excerpt: civilization is protected behind the walls of great poleis
claims.summary: The plane primer presents Meletis, Akros and Setessa as major poleis where mortals have sustained organized civilization.
claims.limitation: These three named cities are examples from the primer; the text does not assert they exhaust every polis on Theros.

claims.subject: minotaur_raiders_theros
claims.summary: Theros's cave-dwelling minotaurs are described as dangers to travelers.
claims.limitation: A general environmental threat, not proof of a named attack or a single organized minotaur faction.

claims.subject: giants_theros
claims.source_excerpt: drawing strength from the terrain on which they tread
claims.summary: Theros's giants gain strength from the terrain on which they walk, according to the official plane primer.
claims.limitation: The source does not quantify a rules effect or identify a specific giant or terrain type.

claims.subject: krakens_theros
claims.summary: The seas of Theros contain great krakens that threaten maritime journeys.
claims.limitation: No named kraken, sea, or incident is verified by this general description.

claims.subject: sirens_theros
claims.source_excerpt: sirens lure its sailors to their demise
claims.summary: Sirens lure Theros sailors to deadly outcomes in the official plane's general account.
claims.limitation: Do not infer a particular voyage or named victim from this environmental overview.

claims.subject: meletis
claims.source_excerpt: polis of learning, progress, magic, and devotion to the gods
claims.summary: Meletis is identified with learning, progress, magic, and devotion to the gods.
claims.limitation: Civic ideals do not prove that every Meletian shares them or that a particular institution held power.

claims.subject: akros
claims.source_excerpt: martial prowess is held in the highest esteem
claims.summary: The polis of Akros emphasizes martial prowess and celebrates its renowned warriors.
claims.limitation: This is a cultural characterization, not an exhaustive Akroan military hierarchy.

claims.subject: setessa
claims.source_excerpt: all in Setessa share a veneration of nature
claims.summary: The official profile describes Setessa as independent and devoted to nature.
claims.limitation: A broad portrayal of the polis, not a dated law, leader's action, or every individual's stated belief.

claims.subject: akros_outposts
claims.source_excerpt: outposts that serve to protect the rest of Theros
claims.summary: Akros's cliff-top fortress is linked to an outpost network protecting areas beyond its walls.
claims.limitation: This describes a defensive function; it does not verify every defended territory or a specific dated war.
